Whipple-Supercharged 5.0L Coyote V8

At the heart of this Mustang is Ford's legendary 5.0L Coyote V8, paired with a Whipple supercharger one of the most sought-after combinations in the modern Mustang performance world.

Finished in Shadow Black over Black Onyx, this is a GT Premium Convertible that can be enjoyed as a comfortable grand tourer one moment and become an entirely different machine when you open the throttle.

The 2027 Chevrolet Traverse LT delivers the spacious three-row capability and reliable performance you need for family adventures and everyday hauling.

This midsize SUV comes equipped with the features that matter most:

- 3rd row seating
- Back up camera
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Heated seats
- Navigation system
- Remote start
- Sunroof
- Front dual zone A/C
- Remote keyless entry
- Active Cruise Control
- Power liftgate
- Heated door mirrors
- Alloy wheels

The Traverse LT combines practicality with comfort through thoughtful design. Its third-row seating accommodates up to eight passengers, making it ideal for larger families or those who frequently transport groups. The backup camera provides added confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces, while the power liftgate makes loading groceries and cargo effortless after a long day.

Climate control is a priority in this model. Dual-zone front air conditioning lets driver and front passenger set their preferred temperatures independently, while rear air conditioning keeps those in the second and third rows comfortable. Heated seats and a heated steering wheel ensure warmth during colder months, and the rear window defroster clears visibility quickly.

Technology integration keeps you connected on every drive. The 17.7-inch diagonal display audio system includes SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel, while OnStar emergency communication provides peace of mind.

Safety systems throughout the Traverse LT work together to protect your passengers. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension provide confident handling, while multiple airbags and advanced braking technology offer comprehensive protection. The low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your vehicle's condition.

With its 2.5L DOHC engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission, the Traverse LT delivers 20 city MPG and 26 highway MPG, balancing capability with efficiency. This three-row SUV is ready to become a dependable part of your lifestyle. Visit our showroom to take the wheel and experience its practical design firsthand.

Adaptive Cruise Assist helps maintain consistent speeds and distances, while Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to composed handling. Multiple airbags, including overhead protection, provide comprehensive occupant coverage. The security system and panic alarm offer additional peace of mind.

Stay online and powered up on the go: the built-in mobile hotspot and multiple USB ports provide reliable connectivity and charging for passengers, making long trips or workdays away from the office more productive and comfortable.

Forward collision mitigation, front pedestrian impact prevention and rear collision mitigation work together as a proactive safety net, constantly scanning the road to help prevent or reduce the severity of impacts and give you extra peace of mind in busy traffic.

A rear camera improves visibility when backing and parking, while lane departure prevention and brake assist add corrective interventions when drifting or sudden stops threaten to create a hazardous situation, increasing everyday safety for driver and passengers alike.

Cruise control with steering-wheel controls and the voice-activated integrated navigation system simplify long drives: set your speed, ask for a route and let the truck handle routine speed adjustments so you arrive less fatigued and more relaxed.

With its responsive EcoBoost engine, towing-focused hardware and a contemporary tech and safety package, this Certified 2024 F-150 STX 4WD SuperCrew 5.5 Box is a versatile choice for buyers who need genuine capability and modern convenience. Certified 2025 Honda Pilot TrailSport AWD 3.5L V-6 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, i-VTEC w/VTC with cylinder deactivation and 285HP, paired to a 10-speed automatic; regular unleaded. This TrailSport pairs robust V6 power and a smooth 10-speed gearbox with all-wheel-drive capability to deliver confident on-road manners, composed weekend off-road potential and competitive fuel economy for a three-row family SUV.

Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let you mirror navigation, music and messages without cables, keeping the dash tidy and your focus on the road.

Hands-on steering assist with lane centering reduces the small, continual steering corrections on long trips so highway driving feels less tiring while still requiring driver engagement.

Forward collision mitigation continuously monitors the road ahead and readies the vehicle s systems to help prevent or reduce the severity of a frontal impact when traffic slows suddenly.

Front pedestrian impact prevention actively scans for people while you drive, helping to identify and react to pedestrians in urban settings to add an important layer of protection.

A rear camera with its own washer keeps the backup view clear in poor weather or muddy conditions, making reversing and parking more dependable and less stressful.

Lane departure prevention intervenes when unintentional drifting is detected, applying corrective steering or braking to help keep you safely between the lines.

Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go maintains a safe following distance and can stop and resume in congested traffic, easing the strain of rush-hour and long highway runs.

Brake assist senses emergency braking and automatically boosts stopping power, helping shorten braking distances when a split-second response matters most.

Cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls makes it simple to set and hold a steady speed without touching the accelerator, reducing fatigue on long drives.

A power open and close liftgate provides hands-free convenience for loading gear and groceries, so you can access the cargo area quickly when your hands are full.

This Certified 2025 Honda Pilot TrailSport AWD balances everyday family practicality with capable performance and thoughtful safety technology. The strong V6 and refined automatic transmission give confident passing and towing potential, while the suite of driver aids and connectivity features help make daily commutes, road trips and weekend adventures calmer and more convenient. Contact the dealer to schedule a test drive and see how this Pilot fits your needs.

The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preferences. Memory seating saves your preferred positions, and the power liftgate provides practical access to the cargo area.

Your safety matters. This RDX includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and overhead airbags to help protect occupants. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control work together to help maintain control in challenging conditions. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps keep you centered in your lane, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about tire health.

description:
This 2020 Ford Transit-350 XL offers the practical capacity and reliability your transportation needs demand.

- Back Up Alarm with 102 dB(A) warning capability
- Reverse Sensing System with cross-traffic alert and trailer coverage
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with Bluetooth and dual USB ports
- Blind Spot Information System (BLIS) with trailer coverage
- 15-Passenger Seats across five rows
- Extended Length Running Boards
- Keyless Entry Keypad
- Front Fog Lamps for enhanced visibility
- Rear-Window Defroster
- 110V/150W Power Outlet
- Vehicle Maintenance Monitor with engine hour meter and diagnostics
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Fully automatic headlights
- Rain sensing wipers
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear

The Transit-350 XL is built to handle serious work. With seating for up to 15 passengers distributed across five rows, this van provides exceptional flexibility for shuttle services, group transportation, and fleet operations. The V6 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission with overdrive delivers dependable performance for daily routes and longer hauls alike.

Safety and convenience are integrated throughout this vehicle. The Blind Spot Information System with cross-traffic alert keeps you aware of your surroundings, while the back up alarm and reverse sensing system provide critical assistance during maneuvering. Extended length running boards make entry and exit easier for passengers, and the rear-window defroster ensures clear visibility in challenging weather.

Technology features support your operational efficiency. The SYNC 3 system offers Bluetooth connectivity, dual USB ports, and a 4.0 multi-function display for seamless device integration. The Vehicle Maintenance Monitor tracks critical engine diagnostics including oil life, tire pressure, and DEF information, helping you stay ahead of maintenance schedules. Front fog lamps and automatic headlights adapt to changing light conditions.

Comfort amenities make extended hours manageable. Dual front bucket seats with driver and passenger armrests provide support, while rear air conditioning keeps passengers comfortable throughout the cabin. The 110V/150W power outlet supplies convenient charging for equipment and devices. Large center console and door bins offer practical storage solutions.

This Transit-350 XL represents solid value in commercial and passenger transportation. With its proven platform, comprehensive feature set, and passenger capacity, it's ready for your operation. We invite you to experience this van firsthand and discuss how it fits your specific requirements.

This 2018 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road V6 delivers the capability and durability that serious truck owners demand.

- 3.5L V6 PDI DOHC engine with 278 horsepower and 6-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with TRD Off-Road Package for enhanced trail performance
- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Rear Parking Assist Sonar
- LED Daytime Running Lamps
- Smart Key with Push Button Start
- Auto-Dimming Inside Rear-View Mirror with Compass
- Black Overfenders and Wide Angle Front Fog Lamps
- Power Sliding Rear Window with Privacy Glass
- 120V/400W Deck Mounted AC Power
- Entune Premium JBL Navigation System with App Suite
- SiriusXM AM/FM Radio with CD Player
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Leather Seat Trim with Front Bucket Seats

The TRD Off-Road package equips this truck with serious capability. The 4WD system and off-road suspension geometry give you confidence on challenging terrain, while the robust V6 engine provides the power you need for demanding tasks.

Inside, the cabin offers genuine comfort for long drives. Leather seating, dual-zone climate control, and a premium JBL sound system create an environment that doesn't sacrifice refinement for capability. The navigation system and smartphone integration keep you connected on the road.

Safety and convenience features work together throughout this truck. The blind spot monitoring system, rear cross traffic alert, and rearview camera provide awareness in all directions. Smart key push-button start and power windows add daily convenience to a work-focused vehicle.

The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that stands out on any lot. Sixteen-inch machined alloy wheels and the color-keyed rear bumper reflect the TRD's purposeful design. Black overfenders and wide-angle fog lamps emphasize the truck's off-road character.

With 94,226 miles on the odometer, this Tacoma represents a vehicle that has earned its place in the market. At 18 mpg city and 22 mpg highway, this truck balances power with reasonable fuel efficiency for a full-size pickup.

This is a truck that works as hard as you do. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience the capability the TRD Off-Road platform delivers.

PRIOR RENTAL
This 2018 Ram 2500 SLT delivers the capability and reliability you need for work and life, wrapped in a truck built to perform.

- 6.7L Cummins I-6 Turbodiesel engine with Diesel Exhaust Brake
- 4WD for confident handling in all conditions
- Uconnect 3 with 5 display and SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Integrated Voice Command with Bluetooth connectivity
- Heated power door mirrors
- Rear Power Sliding Window
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags
- 40/20/40 Split Cloth Bench Seat with Front Center Armrest and Storage
- 18 Steel Chrome Clad wheels
- Power steering, windows, and door mirrors
- Remote keyless entry with Tip Start
- All-terrain capable with 3.42 and 3.73 axle ratio options

The Cummins diesel engine at the heart of this truck is engineered for durability and dependable performance. The turbocharged design delivers the torque you expect from a heavy-duty diesel, while advanced features like the Diesel Exhaust Brake and Selective Catalytic Reduction system enhance control and efficiency. With a 10,000 lb GVWR and tow hooks ready for action, this truck handles demanding tasks with confidence.

Climate control, power accessories, and a well-appointed interior make the time you spend behind the wheel comfortable. The 40/20/40 split bench seat provides flexible seating arrangements for passengers and cargo needs. Uconnect 3 connectivity keeps you informed and connected with voice command capabilities and Bluetooth integration, while SiriusXM brings entertainment on long hauls.

Safety technology is integrated throughout the truck. Dual front impact and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control work together with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS to help protect you and your passengers. The ParkView back-up camera adds visibility when maneuvering, an asset whether you're on the job site or in tight parking situations.

The Silver exterior on this 2500 SLT presents a clean, professional appearance with chrome bumpers and a rear step bumper. The truck carries just over 49,000 miles, indicating careful use. This is a vehicle that's ready to work for you right now.

We encourage you to schedule a time to see this truck in person and experience what it offers firsthand.

description:
The 2025 Buick Envista Sport Touring delivers capable performance and everyday functionality in a refined package designed for discerning drivers who value both style and practicality.

- All-Weather Floor Liners
- License Plate Bracket, Front
- 8-Way Power Driver Seat Adjuster

This compact crossover combines efficiency with comfort through its ECOTEC 1.2L turbo engine, which delivers 28 city mpg and 32 highway mpg to keep fuel costs manageable. The 6-speed automatic transmission provides smooth acceleration and responsive driving dynamics appropriate for both commuting and weekend drives.

Inside, the cabin emphasizes comfort and convenience. The driver benefits from an 8-way power seat with 2-way lumbar support, allowing you to find your ideal driving position. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel make cold mornings more pleasant, while the wireless charging pad keeps your devices powered throughout the day. The power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless, and the Rainsense wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions for improved visibility.

Technology integrates seamlessly with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, giving you access to navigation, music, and communication through your smartphone. The SiriusXM trial subscription provides satellite radio entertainment, while the premium 6-speaker audio system with AM/FM radio delivers quality sound. The trip computer and compass provide useful driving information at a glance.

Safety and visibility receive appropriate attention with dual front impact airbags, stability control, traction control, and a rearview camera with parking sensors to assist during reversing maneuvers. Auto high-beam headlights adapt to traffic conditions, and the front anti-roll bar contributes to composed handling. The braking system features ABS and dual front disc brakes for responsive stopping power.

You can come and experience this vehicle here at Ferguson Subaru in Broken Arrow, Ok!

This 2025 Volvo XC90 Plug-In Hybrid T8 Ultra 6 Passenger in Black represents an excellent choice for buyers seeking a sophisticated SUV that combines luxury, performance, and practical versatility for the modern family.

- Active Chassis with Air Suspension
- Lounge Package with Nubuck Headliner and Backrest Massage Front Seats

The XC90 T8 Ultra provides seating for six passengers with a thoughtful layout designed for comfort across all rows. The combination of a 2.0L I4 Hybrid Turbocharged engine paired with plug-in hybrid technology and all-wheel drive delivers capable performance while maintaining efficiency. With automatic transmissions and Geartronic capabilities, this vehicle offers flexibility in how you drive.

Inside, the cabin reflects Volvo's commitment to premium materials and thoughtful design. The Nubuck headliner and genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts create an upscale atmosphere. Dual-zone climate control for front and rear passengers, along with heated and ventilated seating options, ensures comfort for everyone aboard. The integrated navigation system, harman/kardon audio, and dual-screen connectivity keep you informed and entertained.

Safety technologies are comprehensively integrated throughout this model. The 360 View Parking Camera with Park Assist makes maneuvering simpler, while blind spot intervention, lane departure prevention, and pre-collision warning systems work together to help protect occupants. A full complement of airbags, anti-roll bars, and advanced braking systems provide structural and collision protection.

Volvo Certified Pre-Owned vehicles come with comprehensive benefits designed to provide confidence in your purchase. This includes a 170+ Point Inspection, roadside assistance, and a $0 warranty deductible. The transferable limited warranty covers 12 months with unlimited miles and is upgradeable to 5 years and unlimited miles. This 2023 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 ZR2 delivers the capability and comfort you expect from a premium pickup truck. The robust 6.2L V8 engine paired with the 10-Speed Automatic transmission provides the power needed for demanding work and towing, while the 4WD system ensures confident handling across varied terrain and weather conditions. With 50,135 miles, this truck remains well-maintained and ready for years of dependable service.

The ZR2 is engineered for serious performance. The ZR2 Suspension Package combined with Hill Descent Control gives you enhanced capability whether navigating challenging trails or managing steep grades. The Multi-Flex Tailgate offers six functional load and access features, making everyday truck tasks simpler and more efficient. The Trailering Package includes an Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Hitch Guidance with Hitch View to streamline towing operations.

Technology seamlessly integrates with your lifestyle. The 15 Diagonal Head-Up Display keeps critical information in your line of sight, while the Rear Camera Mirror and HD Surround Vision provide comprehensive visibility. Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connects your devices wirelessly. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio and the Premium Bose 7-Speaker Sound System deliver entertainment throughout your drive.

Comfort features make the cab a welcoming workspace. Heated and ventilated front seats with a heated steering wheel adapt to changing seasons. The 10-Way power adjustable driver and passenger seats with lumbar support reduce fatigue during long hauls. The second row offers heated outboard seats and a center armrest for passenger convenience.

Safety technology provides peace of mind on every journey. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Front Pedestrian Braking work together to help prevent accidents. Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning helps maintain your position in traffic, while Rear Cross Traffic Alert-Braking and Rear Pedestrian Alert protect against unseen hazards when reversing.

This Silverado 1500 ZR2 in Gray represents serious truck capability combined with premium comfort and advanced technology. The combination of towing capacity, intelligent suspension, and comprehensive safety features makes this a truck built for those who demand performance and sophistication. Schedule your visit to experience the capability and refinement this truck delivers.
